title: Echenique–Fryer Spectral Segregation Index: primary references
paper: A Measure of Segregation Based on Social Interactions; QJE 122(2), 2007, pp. 441–485; author PDF June 2006 version

citations.distance_and_classification: Paper PDF pages 24–25, Section VI.B: Census blocks, majority race/ethnicity, 1 km neighborhoods, inverse all-race degree; notes density is ignored.
citations.components_and_local_scaling: Paper PDF page 31, Appendix 1: sum-one right eigenvector x, local SSI lambda * component_size * x. PDF pages 14–15 describe component averaging.
citations.isolation: Paper PDF page 31, Proposition 3: no same-race neighbors implies local SSI zero. Author neighbors.m lines 64–69 removes zero all-race-degree nodes from aggregation sizes.
citations.code_self_links: neighbors.m lines 35–42: j starts at i+1; great-circle radius 6378.1 km; inclusive distance <= threshold; all-race degree increments before same-race test.
citations.code_aggregation: blockspectral.m lines 155–166: sum(lambda*component_size)/eligible_race_nodes; eligible nodes exclude zero all-race-degree nodes.
citations.classification_limit: Paper PDF pages 24–25 says majority; author webpage says predominant. The public MATLAB reads preassigned integer race labels and the linked author repository contains no preprocessing code. In the first 10000 published 2000-block records, every assigned label maximizes White, Black, Asian, Hispanic counts; 91 labeled blocks have maximum share below 50%. All 31 ties choose the last maximum in White, Black, Asian, Hispanic order. This is direct evidence for plurality rather than strict >50%; tie policy is a documented replication convention supported by this nonrandom sample, not a claim about uninspected original records.
citations.code_local_scaling_and_published_data: blockspectral.m lines 129–140 exports lambda*x after normalizing sum(x)=1; callspec.m lines 27–34 saves it. Author published block data separately contains littlesi (documented as block SSI), consistent with blocksi * component_size in the first 10000 records; this restores the paper Appendix 1 formula lambda * component_size * x. Thus intermediate MATLAB blocksi should not be mistaken for final local SSI.

methodology_notes: City-limit boundaries, 2020 populations, category definitions and tract-node companion analyses differ from the original MSA/2000/block application.
For user-requested population-share adjustment, K counts all city residents and is not the fraction of dominant-category or eligible nodes.
The requested SSI-K and (SSI-K)/(1-K) differ from the paper simulated-baseline adjustment.

The published original category counts overlap with Hispanic, so overlap itself is consistent with the released data. Dominant-category classification nevertheless forces one label per populated block. This differs from the fractional-race PSSI construction.

Paper-scaled local SSI = lambda * component_size * sum-one eigenvector entry can exceed 1. Component eigenvalues and city averages are bounded by 1; local values must not be clipped or mislabeled as eigenvalues.

published_data_audit.scope: First 10000 published rows only; source was streamed, not fully downloaded; row sample SHA256 and retrieval time are included in the audit.

recommended_output_labels.excluded_all_neighbor_isolates: Dominant-[race] blocks with no other populated block within the distance threshold
recommended_output_labels.eligible_race_nodes: Eligible dominant-[race] blocks: at least one other populated block within the distance threshold
recommended_output_labels.same_race_isolates_in_denominator: Eligible dominant-[race] blocks with no same-category neighbor (local SSI = 0; included in denominator)
recommended_output_labels.city_ssi: Sum of component eigenvalue × component block count / eligible dominant-category block count
recommended_output_labels.component_lambda: Perron eigenvalue of the block’s same-category connected component
recommended_output_labels.perron_sum_one: Component right eigenvector entry, normalized to sum to one within its component
recommended_output_labels.local_ssi: Component eigenvalue × component block count × component sum-one eigenvector entry
recommended_output_labels.population_K: [Race] population divided by total city population; all city residents remain in K, irrespective of node labels or isolation

recommended_edge_conventions.distance: great-circle distance <= radius, excluding self; author Earth radius 6378.1 km
recommended_edge_conventions.degree: all populated blocks within threshold, regardless of dominant category; then restrict rows and columns to category for B
recommended_edge_conventions.unknown_category: If all four counts are zero, keep block as unclassified in all-neighbor degree rather than force a false category; report this explicit extension, because supplied author code expects preassigned labels.
recommended_edge_conventions.eligible_none: NaN/undefined when no eligible nodes exist for the category, with count=0; do not present a genuine zero SSI.
recommended_edge_conventions.K_one: Normalized (SSI-K)/(1-K) is undefined when K=1; retain NaN.

source_line_number_note: neighbors.m contains mixed CR/LF line endings; cited line numbers count universal-newline logical lines (Python read_text().splitlines()), while all source bytes remain unmodified for checksums.
